subject.title: fix(gateway): reap stale MCP processes on session reset regardless of…

question: Which MCP retirement contract should this PR use before merge: drained-only, force-clear-then-retire, or deferred retirement after active MCP leases release?
rationale: The patch touches gateway session teardown and MCP process ownership; source evidence shows direct disposal can race active leases, so automation should not choose the permanent lifecycle semantics without maintainer intent.

options.title: Require lease-aware deferred retirement
options.body: Block merge until runtime retirement can be marked pending and completed after the final active MCP lease releases, covering timeout paths without killing in-flight tool work.

options.title: Require force-clear before retirement
options.body: Allow retirement on timeout only if the embedded run is explicitly force-cleared first and tests prove no live MCP work can continue afterward.

options.title: Pause for broader MCP runtime repair
options.body: Close or pause this branch if maintainers want the stale-process cluster solved in the MCP runtime manager rather than gateway reset/delete cleanup.

recommendation.title: Require lease-aware deferred retirement
recommendation.body: Block merge until runtime retirement can be marked pending and completed after the final active MCP lease releases, covering timeout paths without killing in-flight tool work.
